title: Frontend choice: Open WebUI Computer as the workspace shell
hypothesis: An existing workspace product plus Haven's executor beats building a new IDE.
finding: cptr 0.9.21: workspace, file edit, persistent terminal, git diff/commit, chats that resume after reload, local Qwen calling Haven tools over MCP with receipts. Problems found: rich Markdown editor rewrites unrelated lines; auto-edits .gitignore; no per-user isolation; ELv2-based licence. See docs/FRONTEND_EVALUATION.md.
limits: OpenCode end-to-end with the 4B model, Open WebUI + Open Terminal and Hermes Agent were not run.
